subject: ext-ft
title: EXT.F.------TH.CONT.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 264 (CMBA-20). EXT-FT (extended functionalism) is the subject; TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the partner. The title names EXT-F (extended functionalism); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From ALT-C-PG: INFO-DOC (information documentation), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion", AFI (affinity insight) and PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism). From PROG-EXT-FT: MT-INFO (multi-information) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From MT-INFO: PER-TRS (perceived transition) and MPP-RDEF.
